identity: CPython 3.12.3, Ubuntu source package 3.12.3-1ubuntu0.17, amd64 retained package profile
proof_start: First exception successfully delivered and bound at handler entry; earliest underlying allocation failure identity is not guaranteed.
guarantees_under_premises: Initialized STORE_FAST/STORE_DEREF stores do not allocate; reference destruction remains relevant.
Valid exact-list/exact-int index replacement into a None slot takes a strong reference without resizing, allocating, or consulting the error object.
Bounded exact-int additions with result in -5 through 256 use cached objects; precomputed successors are admissible.
An authentic writable native T_OBJECT or T_OBJECT_EX slot has the same pointer-store/decref core; generic attribute assignment is not included.
Captured original posix.close(fd) reaches exactly one native close call if call entry/argument conversion succeed; ownership is consumed before the attempt and never retried.
Explicit operation-local primary state distinguishes successful local operations from older callers handling unrelated exceptions.
premises: Authentic attested runtime, original bytecode/functions/native primitives, trusted operating system and protected private state.
No intervening async exception injection, tracing/profiling/monitoring callbacks, concurrent mutation or hostile finalizers on the protected failure path.

Sufficient native-call recursion headroom; successful exception delivery and subsequent unwind where required. Python helper-frame allocation failure is not assumed away: inline-retain before guarded helper entry.
All primary/secondary/overflow/status/descriptor storage and labels exist before first protected I/O, and remain strongly rooted by their owner.
Exact lists, exact bounded integer indices/counters and source-owned monotone cursor; no unvalidated __index__, __setitem__, __setattr__, descriptor or owner helper.
Each overwritten slot/local predecessor is None or a controlled native scalar, or separately rooted so the store cannot trigger its destruction.

Capacity covers every admitted failure plus remaining owned-descriptor cleanup and serialization; first overflow is retained, evidence becomes incomplete, and further unrooted foreign errors are outside the guarantee.
No allocating function/helper/tuple/list/iterator/record/logging/formatting operation precedes required FD cleanup unless independently protected with original primary already retained.
forbidden_in_primitive_region: list.append or construction of tuples, dataclasses, dictionaries, strings, formatted errors, logging records or iterators
recycling foreign-error slots or dropping the last retained error reference

Bind source and actual runtime/process/primitive identity; source/package linkage is not independent binary equivalence.
Keep first primary rooted through cleanup and terminal handoff; distinguish in-process roots from durable evidence.

Attempt all already owned descriptor cleanups before best-effort serialization; preserve literal incomplete-evidence fallback without promising it can be written.
Retain actual unconfirmed states, bound/cost all new storage and controls, and obtain separate runtime/integration approval.

A.before_call: Set preallocated pending-acquisition token before authentic native open; forbid concurrent/reentrant acquisition.
A.success: Store returned exact FD into private slot before clearing pending.
A.failure: Inline-retain original and quarantine before any helper or deferred capture; clean all known tokens; admit no further acquisitions; STOP with at most one unreturned possible FD until parent kernel teardown.
A.evidence: Unknown descriptor is not confirmed closed. Reservation/budget must include known plus pending/uncertain ownership. Successful handler delivery and stop/parent teardown remain premises.

B.premises: Complete total live descriptor occupancy including inherited, census and transient descriptors at most240; at most3 further descriptor allocations and no other acquisition/race; authenticated Linux lowest-free descriptor allocation.
B.deduction: At most243 occupied descriptors leaves a free index among0..256; successful open result then uses cached CPython integer.
B.unestablished: No full occupancy/call-graph census or exact pinned kernel allocator source verified. Owned-descriptor count alone is insufficient.
